another repository's history: 8455807 is a commit in VetTrack---RN-Migration-, cited in this log because it is the counter-example that made the all-decimal sha heuristic wrong (roughly one short sha in twenty-five is all digits). The cross-repo mechanism resolves PATHS by prefix and PULL REQUESTS by qualifier; it has no equivalent for a commit, so this is registered rather than silently reworded. Re-verify with: git -C ../VetTrack---RN-Migration- cat-file -e 8455807^{commit}
